messages.subject: Error in fitting pcounOpen model
parts:
Dear colleagues,

I am beginner in unmarked. I am trying to fit the model of Dail and
Madsen to my data using pcountOpen. I am starting with the

simplest model. However, I am getting an error:

> fm0 <- pcountOpen(~1, ~1, ~1, ~1, uFPCO, mixture="P", K=30)
Error in rep(0, nP) : invalid 'times' argument
In addition: Warning message:
In max(delta, na.rm = TRUE) :
no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf

Anything wrong with my input data?
The data was imported from the database into R and then structured
using "formatMulti". yealySiteCovs were added later

Thanks Richard,

objects are alike and the dataframe created by formatMult can be used
in any of the commands.
However, when I tried to structure the dataset using unmarkedFramePCO
command I got another error:

> siteCovs(MyMult)$Marsruta_ID<-as.factor(siteCovs(MyMult)$Marsruta_ID)

> MySiteCovs<-siteCovs(MyMult)
> MyObsCovs<-obsCovs(MyMult)

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Re: Error in fitting pcounOpen model
parts:
Hi again,

The error is telling you that "primaryPeriod" (not "PrimaryPeriod") should be a matrix. But it optional and only needed if the time intervals between primary periods are variable. I'm pretty sure you are trying to use "primaryPeriod" incorrectly. Try something simple like

uFPCO <- unmarkedFramePCO(y=Myy, numPrimary=7)

Richard
_____________________________________
Richard Chandler, post-doc
USGS Patuxent Wildlife Research Center
